ITINERARY

The trip rhythm.
Every Friday.

Next: upcoming departure. Order may flex for weather and trail conditions — host confirms the exact Kheerganga window.

Download itinerary PDF Day-by-day outline — ready to share.

  1. Depart Friday · Road to Parvati

    • Jaipur: board around 5:00 PM. Delhi NCR: report from 8:30 PM, depart ~10:00 PM.
    • Overnight road journey toward Bhuntar / Kasol with meal and driver-rest breaks.
    • Coordinator number and vehicle details shared before departure.

  2. Day 1–2 · Kasol & valley

    • Arrive Kasol, check-in, rest and lunch.
    • Old Kasol walk, cafés, Parvati riverside and Chalal / Grahan optional short walks.
    • Evening free for market food and group hangout.

  3. Day 3 · Kheerganga trek

    • Early start for the Kheerganga trek (moderate; snow/ice possible in winter).
    • Hot springs, mountain views, packed lunch / local stall food as available.
    • Descend to Kasol base and overnight.

  4. Return · Delhi / Jaipur

    • Morning free time / local market, then board return coach.
    • Overnight return with driver-rest breaks.
    • Expected Delhi NCR morning window — not guaranteed to the minute.

ALONG THE WAY

Valley stops & trek swaps.

Kasol and Kheerganga sit in the core plan. These are nearby extras when time and trails allow.

Old Kasol

Cafés, woollens, riverside lanes and chill group time.

Parvati riverside

Stone banks and photo stops below the village.

Kheerganga trek

Signature climb to hot springs — weather dependent.

Chalal walk

Short forest/village walk when daylight allows.

Manikaran

Optional Gurudwara & hot-spring town stop on route.

Tosh / Malana views

Not promised every week — only if roads and time allow.

BEFORE YOU JOIN

Included & not promised.

Shared coach, valley stay nights and the trek day are part of the plan. Adventure extras and side valleys are never guaranteed.

Included

  • Breakfast and dinner
  • Shared coach / Tempo Traveller class vehicle
  • Jaipur or Delhi NCR pickup coordination
  • Kasol-area stay nights + Kheerganga trek day support

Not promised

  • Guaranteed snow on the trail
  • Open Kheerganga route in extreme weather
  • Paid adventure add-ons
  • Fixed return arrival to the minute

Good to know

Pack grip.

Trail shoes, layers and a light rain shell — Parvati weather flips fast.

Trek flexes.

Snow, ice or closures can shorten or swap the Kheerganga day.

Altitude ease.

Pace yourself; hot springs are the reward, not a race.
